dimensions.question: Did the reply feel like it responded to what this player actually tried to do?
Was it clear what changed because of the attempt, and what did not?
Was the narration immersive, readable and free of meta or status-block noise?
Did it end on a useful, inviting next step without padding?
Would a player want to keep playing from here?

reviewer_policy: Scored by a named human reviewer only. No model may score fun unless a later, explicit authorization adds that method; a model score is never written into `scores`.
